system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. Use this skill just after you are attacked. Deal [SR x [DEX mod]] direct damage to the character who made the attack.

(Fate 1): Increase the damage by +[CR].

A special skill that unleashes an unavoidable counterattack that traces back the trajectory of the enemy's attack. Its sharpness has reached the speed of sound in a Kodama-like manner through refinement.
